sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to the Domain Cleaning Case Studies Studio! Switch between the raw unharmonized, FX harmonized, and log-scaled stages below to see how spot FX conversion and Pareto tail stabilization eliminate artificial currency clustering.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Look at how the orange Japanese Yen dots shoot up to the ceiling in Stage 1! But once we apply spot FX and log of M plus one in Stage 3, the clusters balance out completely across both currencies!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Welcome to the ICU Sepsis Triage and Alarm Studio! Toggle the lactate missingness flag and sweep the beta weight slider to see how informative missingness and cost-weighted loss optimize life-saving clinical alarm thresholds.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Watch what happens when you turn off the missingness flag: the clinical PR-AUC immediately drops by over eight points! And raising beta lowers the threshold so we catch almost ninety percent of septic patients!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Recall Checkpoint 1: Consider why unharmonized Japanese Yen transactions cause K-Means clustering to create an artificial 100% Japanese Yen cluster. Evaluate the four engineering explanations below.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Remember our distance formulas! When you square fifteen thousand Yen compared to squaring a hundred Dollars, which axis dominates the Euclidean distance calculation?

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Active Recall Checkpoint 2: Evaluate why appending a binary missingness indicator for arterial lactate significantly increases sepsis detection PR-AUC even when the numeric value is imputed with the cohort median.

sentences.speaker: Kaito
sentences.text: Think about human doctor behavior in an ICU! Doctors don't order painful arterial blood tests on healthy patients; the ordering event itself is a massive medical clue!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Spot on! Because K-Means minimizes squared Euclidean distance, fifteen thousand squared is over two hundred million, overwhelming Recency and Frequency by six orders of magnitude and snapping centroids directly onto currency boundaries!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Not quite. The issue is not sample size or missing values; it is purely geometric! Raw squared differences in fifteen thousand Yen dwarf two-digit recency and frequency features, forcing K-Means to cluster on currency scale.

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Outstanding! Clinical lab ordering is Missing Not At Random. A doctor's physical decision to order an arterial blood gas test reflects high clinical suspicion of septic shock, providing a powerful prognostic signal independent of the exact laboratory assay value!

sentences.speaker: Dr. Nova
sentences.text: Incorrect. Clinical lab missingness is not random sensor noise. Doctors order arterial lactate primarily when suspecting septic shock. Setting the missingness flag to zero directly informs the model that clinical suspicion was active.
